title: GLY 102 - Earth Surface Processes and Historical Geology

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Geological map?
o: the interval of time that an unconformity represents but does not show
inclined internal layers laid down by currents moving over a bedform
a map showing where each rock unit reaches the ground surface
the wearing away and removal of rock or loose material by a moving agent
items.s: Geological map: a map showing where each rock unit reaches the ground surface. The other options describe Erosion, Hiatus, Cross-bedding.

items.q: The statement “the laying down of transported sediment when the carrying agent loses energy” describes which of the following?
o: Evaporite
Compaction
Diagenesis
Deposition
items.s: Deposition is the laying down of transported sediment when the carrying agent loses energy.

items.q: The statement “a smaller named division recognised within a formation” describes which of the following?

Principle of original horizontality
Stratigraphy
Principle of superposition
items.s: Member is a smaller named division recognised within a formation.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Erosion.
o: a smaller named division recognised within a formation
the downhill movement of soil and rock under the pull of gravity
the crumbling of rock by salt crystals growing inside its pores
the wearing away and removal of rock or loose material by a moving agent
items.s: Erosion: the wearing away and removal of rock or loose material by a moving agent. The other options describe Mass wasting, Salt weathering, Member.

items.q: The statement “a bend in rock layers produced by compression while the rock stayed solid” describes which of the following?

items.s: Fold is a bend in rock layers produced by compression while the rock stayed solid.

an erosion surface between parallel beds that hides a gap in time
